meaning:
edict, decree
Aramaic equivalent: pit.gam (פִּתְגָם "edict" H6600)

elsewhere.note: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great…
Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
